llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must explicitly set Home as the initial tab route.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Tab.Navigator is rendered with initialRouteName="Home" explicitly set.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must construct navigation with React Navigation static API and render it via `createStaticNavigation(...)`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: createStaticNavigation is imported from @react-navigation/native and used to construct AppNavigation, which is rendered as <AppNavigation /> in the App component.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must define three bottom tab routes named Home, Search, Profile using `createBottomTabNavigator` from `@react-navigation/bottom-tabs`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: createBottomTabNavigator is imported from @react-navigation/bottom-tabs and three Tab.Screen components named Home, Search, and Profile are defined.
